identification: Pallet of damaged giant-scale RC warbird airframe parts (balsa fuselage skeleton, camouflage fuselage, white wings with red tips and RAF roundels, yellow/blue wing), with a small petrol (two-stroke gas) engine, cowl, spinner and propeller. Maker and engine brand not legible. Likely Tiger Moth or Chipmunk style trainer.

viewing_check: Photograph the engine: maker and model on the crankcase (DLE, DA, Zenoah, Saito, Moki), whether it has carb, ignition and muffler, and turns freely; check wingspan, whether servos or receivers remain, and whether airframes are repairable.
